source: paint hide and seek on stud maps of cliffs to desert to town. you play by tap on a wall.and you become that colour. the aim is to hide and not get found by seeker. you can pose differently to help you hide

image_prompt.text: A shared gathering area where players wait before and between rounds, sized for the full server
Dense repeating clutter: boulders, scrub, dunes, crates and town props, arranged to break sightlines for hiding
The town section built as a warren of walled streets, alleys and doorways to hide in and be hunted through
Three linked areas running from rocky cliffs, through open desert, into a small town
Large flat single-colour wall surfaces throughout every area that a player can tap to take on that colour

notes: obstacle-maze routes P6: the town warren must be valid by construction.
Colour-matching camouflage (tap a wall, become its colour) and the hiding poses are avatar and scripting behaviour with no spatial footprint, carried for the pipeline but not placed.
Read 'stud maps of cliffs to desert to town' as three linked areas inside one build. If the user means three separate maps in rotation, this becomes P4.
The map only works if wall surfaces are large, flat and distinctly coloured: a constraint on the image, not an option.

open_questions.ask: Should the three areas be realistic, or flat and toon-bright so the colour-matching reads clearly?
Are cliffs, desert and town one continuous map, or three separate maps the round rotates between?
How does a round end: a timer the hiders have to survive, or the seeker finding everyone?

theme: Natural cliffs and open desert giving way to a small town, with flat strongly-coloured surfaces

answers.ask: Should the three areas be realistic, or flat and toon-bright so the colour-matching reads clearly?
answers.answer: Use a flat, toon-bright look so wall colours are easy to read and match.

answers.ask: Are cliffs, desert and town one continuous map, or three separate maps the round rotates between?
answers.answer: Make them three separate small maps, with the round rotating between cliffs, desert, and town.

answers.ask: How does a round end: a timer the hiders have to survive, or the seeker finding everyone?
answers.answer: A round ends when the seeker finds everyone; hiders win if they remain hidden until the round timer runs out.
